en:
&
There's a shrine! We'll pray here for our victory!

......

...Hm? What's this? A scrap of paper? There's something written on it!
note: Speaker line is a bare '&' (no portrait); copied as is. Speaker unknown (a Mouri unit commander), so no name added. 'We' = the Mouri side praying for victory.

en:
"Four paces south of this spot
I have buried my treasure."

note: Same text as U02104 (only the Japanese line breaks differ); identical English.
Glossary battle_ui pattern 'X joined your army.' with period (U02131 is the documented 36-char exception without one).
Glossary pattern; with a final period it is 37 chars (limit 36), so the period is dropped (as in U00694). Shared by 2 occurrences.
Bare '&' speaker = an unnamed enemy soldier; copied as is.

en: Ep. 9: Lesson of the Three Arrows
note: Glossary 'Episode 9: Lesson of the Three Arrows' is 37 chars, title limit 36. Kept the glossary wording, prefix shortened to 'Ep. 9:' (33). Alt: 'Episode 9: The Three Arrows' Lesson' (35). Shared by 2 occurrences.

en:
On November 30, 1545,
Okata, Motonari's wife, with her
beloved husband and three
children at her side, quietly
passed away. She was 47.

note: Tsuneyo attends the funeral; 'you' = Motonari. Leads to U02164.
Jiro speaks to his younger brother Tokujumaru, who lingers at the grave.
